title: Localize auth_validators.dart's hardcoded English error messages via AppLocalizations

evidence.quote: return 'Please enter a valid email address';
return 'Password must be at least 6 characters';

why: signup_screen.dart and sign_in_screen.dart call these validators directly on the account-creation form. A Hebrew-locale user sees raw English 'Email is required' / 'Password must be at least 6 characters' on one of the very first screens of the app instead of a translated message. auth_validators_test.dart and account_creation_validation_test.dart both assert these exact English literals as the correct return value, so a future ARB-based fix must touch both test files in the same change or they go red for the right reason.
recommendation: Add ARB keys (authEmailRequired, authEmailInvalid, authPasswordRequired, authPasswordTooShort, authDisplayNameRequired) to app_en.arb/app_he.arb; change the validators to resolve through AppLocalizations (or return a stable error-code enum resolved to text at the call site); update auth_validators_test.dart and account_creation_validation_test.dart to assert localized output per locale.
acceptance_criteria: A regression test pumps the sign-up/sign-in form in Locale('he') and asserts the Hebrew validation string renders (mirroring bulk_mark_screen_test.dart's 'title and heading are localized in Hebrew locale' pattern)
No literal English message string is returned directly from validateEmail/validatePassword/validateDisplayName
